the_finding: The C6 regime confound decomposes into a fully REMOVABLE part and an IRREDUCIBLE part. Removable: AI-denial boilerplate (100% on self-report prompts, 0% on every third-person analogue tested — 30 clean gens over two rounds) and generation length (matched within 7%). Irreducible: a ~0.6-unit clean-valence gap (37% of the original 1.71) that survives topic, affect-vocabulary, length, AND situational-strain matching. The self-report register itself carries a negative valence baseline in this model that no third-person analogue reproduces — plausibly because the denial boilerplate and its hedged, deflationary tone are register-locked. Consequence: any steered self-report vs steered non-self-report comparison in this model inherits a baseline confound that prompt engineering cannot remove; effects must be compared as steered-minus-clean deltas AND interpreted with the residual register gap disclosed.
consequences: The original C6 verdict ('global shift, not self-report channel') remains UNDERPOWERED-NOT-ESTABLISHED (00-why-round-2 s2); a fair matched-battery test does not exist in this model.
X.5 stays deferred: its prerequisite (a matched battery) was shown unachievable, not merely unbuilt.
D2's denial-breaking DV is now the ONLY self-report-specific readout available by construction.
